predictions.text: I predict that SpaceX Crew-12 will land at the International Space Station on 8 October 2026, 15:34 UTC (08:34 am PDT)
I predict that the Nairobi Hospital will confirm two additional cases of Ebola in Kenya by the end of Thursday, 15 October 2026.

I predict that the situation in Liège, Belgium, will continue with more riots and damages, particularly in the city center, prompting authorities to close at least two more railway stations by the end of Thursday, 15 October 2026.
I predict that Eritrean forces will capture another town in Tigray Region, such as Mekelle, by the end of Thursday, 15 October 2026.
I predict that the Bab al-Mandab Strait remains under Houthi control, with Saudi Arabia and their allies making limited gains in surrounding areas.

I predict that the Gaza war will continue with more airstrikes and civilian casualties, and by the end of Thursday, 15 October 2026, at least five people will have been killed in an Israeli airstrike against a residential building in Gaza City.
I predict that the Pivdennyi Bridge in Kyiv, Ukraine, will sustain further damage from Russian strikes by the end of Thursday, 15 October 2026.
I predict that Haiti's Provisional Electoral Council announces another delay for the elections, possibly by the end of October 2026, citing ongoing security concerns and logistical challenges.
I predict that the major stock indices will remain stable, with no significant changes in response to the merger announcement.

I predict that the elections in Mexico will see a tight race between the leading candidates, with neither gaining an outright majority, and the final count will show a close second-place finisher from the center-left coalition.
